subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour onboarding experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, narrowed to sample-preview pieces, or paused in favor of the current onboarding baseline?
rationale: The blocker is not only mechanical: current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions, while this PR adds a new preview/sample first-run product surface.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, conflict resolution, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview pieces
options.body: Extract only the still-wanted preview/sample experience after maintainers choose the current onboarding baseline.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the merged onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, conflict resolution, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh merged the current-main onboarding/security setup changes that now define the baseline this PR must rebase onto.
